name: The Blue Moon
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria and Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1951</u> London: HMSO, 1962.
summary: A Chinese Fairy-Tale. One of eight wood engraving illustrations by Clemence Housman to 'The Blue Moon' by Laurence Housman, after drawings by the author. Published by John Murray, 1904.
